brand.name: CASSIA
brand.tagline: An immersive sensory destination where culinary modernism, single-origin roasts, and craft botanicals converge.

anthology.sectionDesc: Explore our curated culinary pillars — from charcoal live-fire delicacies and third-wave micro-lot coffee to artisanal cocktail chemistry and evocative dining salons. Click any chapter to inspect the dedicated menu.

contact.hoursNote: Kitchen closes 45 minutes prior to closing. Bar open late on weekends.
contact.valetNote: Complimentary white-glove valet parking is provided at our porte-cochère entrance for all dining and bar guests.

cards.title: Progressive World Cuisine
cards.excerpt: Modern European precision interwoven with regional Awadhi and Indian coastal spices. Prepared over live charcoal and served on hand-thrown ceramics.

cards.title: The Artisanal Brew Bar
cards.excerpt: Sourced from eighteen single-origin estates across Chikmagalur, Yirgacheffe, and Oaxaca. Extracted through slow hand pour-overs, nitro cold taps, and wild cassia infusions.

cards.title: Botanicals & Rare Spirits
cards.excerpt: A cocktail laboratory dedicated to hydro-distilled floral waters, oak-barrel-aged vermouths, torched cassia quills, and crystal-cut hand-carved ice.

cards.title: An Architectural Sanctuary
cards.excerpt: Designed with muted charcoal tones, natural linen, soft acoustic textures, and low amber lighting designed to make hours dissolve into unhurried conversation.

cards.title: Events & Chef Degustation
cards.excerpt: From weekend acoustic jazz sessions and vinyl listening lounges to private multi-course pairings hosted directly at the Executive Chef’s counter.

dishes.name: Pan-Seared Himalayan Trout
dishes.notes: Saffron Emulsion · Charred Wild Asparagus · 24K Leaf
dishes.desc: Pristine mountain brook trout pan-seared in clarified butter, rested over smooth saffron purée, edible gold, and black truffle shavings.

dishes.name: Truffle Morel Brioche & Burrata
dishes.notes: Wild Himalayan Guchhi · Organic Burrata · 12-Yr Balsamic
dishes.desc: Butter-toasted brioche smothered with pan-roasted wild guchhi morels and hand-torn organic burrata in a white wine reduction.

dishes.name: Slow-Simmered Awadhi Dum Biryani
dishes.notes: Aged Basmati · Rose Water · Cassia Clay Handi
dishes.desc: Prime cuts braised in spiced yogurt and layered under dough pastry with long-grain basmati scented with kewra and crushed cassia quills.

dishes.name: Burrata & Raw Mango Chaat
dishes.notes: Whipped Burrata · Spiced Mango Reduction · Urad Dal Crisp
dishes.desc: Artisanal burrata paired with a piquant raw mango glaze and crispy lentil wafers, finished with fresh micro-coriander.

dishes.name: Smoked Wild Mushroom Tart
dishes.notes: Morel & Shiitake · Cassia Bark Crust · Black Garlic
dishes.desc: Wild woodland mushrooms baked with goat cheese in a flaky butter pastry infused with crushed Ceylon cinnamon bark.

dishes.name: Wild Cassia Saffron Cortado
dishes.notes: Kalledevarapura Arabica · Whole Wild Cassia · Mongra Saffron
dishes.desc: Double ristretto pulled over toasted cassia bark, finished with silky microfoam infused with organic Kashmiri saffron threads.

dishes.name: Monsooned Malabar Pour-Over
dishes.notes: V60 Hand-Drip · 3-Min Bloom · Malabar Coastal Curing
dishes.desc: Slow-dripped single origin offering a heavy velvet body with earthen notes of pipe tobacco and toasted baker’s cocoa.

dishes.name: Nitro Cold Brew with Cassia Cream
dishes.notes: 24-Hour Extraction · Pure Liquid Nitrogen · Spiced Cream
dishes.desc: Slow cold-steeped micro-lot served on nitrogen tap, crowned with a cold-frothed cream infused with ground Ceylon cinnamon.

dishes.name: Smoked Cascara Espresso
dishes.notes: Coffee Cherry Extraction · Himalayan Salt · Sparkling Water
dishes.desc: Concentrated 22g shot extracted through toasted cascara berries, served alongside chilled sparkling mineral water.

dishes.name: Ceremonial Matcha Cortado
dishes.notes: Uji First-Harvest Matcha · Cardamom Essence · Velvety Oat
dishes.desc: Stone-ground ceremonial green tea micro-whisked and balanced with delicate cardamom-infused oat foam.

dishes.name: The Gorakhpur Old Fashioned
dishes.notes: Small-Batch Bourbon · Torched Cassia Quills · Organic Gur
dishes.desc: Aged oak bourbon slow-infused with roasted wild cassia bark, raw jaggery nectar, and flamed orange bitters over crystal obsidian ice.

dishes.name: Midnight Espresso Martini
dishes.notes: Cassia Cold Brew · Valrhona 70% Cacao · Pure Grain Vodka
dishes.desc: Fresh-pulled single origin double shot shaken hard with grain vodka, dark Belgian cacao liquor, and a whisper of smoked sea salt.

dishes.name: Saffron Silk Clarified Milk Punch
dishes.notes: 48-Hour Milk Wash · Spiced Rum · Kashmiri Petals · Yuzu
dishes.desc: Crystal-clear milk-washed aperitif infused with green cardamom, roasted almonds, and saffron threads for a velvet texture.

dishes.name: Rose & Cardamom Fizz
dishes.notes: Botanical Gin · Kannauj Rose Water · Fresh Citrus · Prosecco
dishes.desc: Artisanal gin perfumed with hydro-distilled Kannauj rose extract, fresh lime juice, and Italian sparkling wine.

dishes.name: Royal Terai Botanist (Zero-Proof)
dishes.notes: Non-Alcoholic Botanical Distillate · Lychee Shrub · Smoked Rosemary
dishes.desc: Zero-proof craft elixir with Terai foothills lychee reduction, aromatic tonic, and torched garden rosemary.

dishes.name: The Grand Dining Salon
dishes.notes: Civil Lines Heritage Wing · Amber Candlelight · Low Acoustics
dishes.desc: Our flagship dining room framed with dark walnut, tactile linen, and subdued lighting crafted for lingering evening dinners.

dishes.name: The Chef’s Counter Seating
dishes.notes: Direct Kitchen Sightlines · Live Plating · 6 Dedicated Seats
dishes.desc: An interactive high-top culinary counter overlooking executive chefs preparing woodfire reductions and seasonal tastings.

dishes.name: The Private Amber Salon
dishes.notes: Dedicated Sommelier · Private Audio · Bespoke Tasting Menu
dishes.desc: An exclusive enclosed chamber for celebratory dinners, wine pairings, and private corporate engagements.

dishes.name: The Verandah Coffee Lounge
dishes.notes: Natural Sunlit Courtyard · Artisan Brews · Patisserie
dishes.desc: An airy sanctuary designed for morning coffee rituals, slow reading, and midday artisan pastry pairing.

dishes.name: Friday Acoustic Jazz & Wine Pairings
dishes.notes: Live Double Bass & Saxophone · Sommelier Curated Pours
dishes.desc: Slow, evocative jazz performances paired with organic biodynamic wines and our signature small plates menu.

dishes.name: Saturday Vinyl Lounge & Botanical Bar
dishes.notes: Analog Turntable Sessions · Rare Spirit Cocktails
dishes.desc: Curated analog soul, bossa nova, and ambient grooves accompanied by limited-edition botanical cocktails.

dishes.name: Sunday Slow Degustation Lunch
dishes.notes: 7-Course Slow Menu · Table-Side Culinary Carvings
dishes.desc: An unhurried weekend family banquet honoring slow-simmered regional recipes and artisanal desserts.

dishes.name: Monthly Coffee Cupping & Sensory Workshop
dishes.notes: Led by Head Q-Grader · 6 Flight Bean Tasting
dishes.desc: Learn the chemistry of roasting, calibrated coffee slurping techniques, and bean terroir identification.
